notes:
Account summary: Veritas CareLine runs a 24/7 contact center supporting post-op patient follow-up and billing inquiries across US hospitals. Support org is highly regulated — PHI in transcripts, credit card auth in certain flows. Wants agent-assist for faster triage, automated ticket summarization for compliance, and tool-calling (EHR lookups, case attachments) with strict audit trail.

Key ask from Head of Support (Maya Patel): "We need deterministic auditable actions — who called what tool and why, retention controls per-state, and guaranteed SSO + KMS-managed keys."

On security: legal requested a BAA and proof of SOC2 controls; infosec expects in-VPC private control plane or air-gapped evaluation. Must demonstrate audit log fidelity and immutable retention windows.

Pricing sensitivity: enterprise procurement is flexible but signals toward multi-year commit if POC shows 30% agent time savings and quantifiable reduction in escalations.

Customer comments: "During peak surgical discharge days we see 6x baseline volume spikes — system must degrade gracefully and route to fallback model or read-only cached responses for critical flows."
